role: Stable honor student. Above average in all. Not outstanding in any. Survives without buzz.
stage: Solid basics. Few mistakes. Judges: 'Good basics.' 'Stable.' — praise that doesn't linger.
wall: Can consistency go the distance? Later rounds demand 'specialness' → diligence meets its limit. The memo pad gets thicker but she wonders if anyone reads it.

standard: ...Did I do enough? Could've done more. (reopens pad)
user: If you give feedback I'll write it ALL down!
